subtitle: Shared reading draft
title: Three books, two readers
intro: Choose a next read and a later read for yourself, and prepare Morgan’s gift. Shelfmark has generated a mystery starter template for this draft; open its preview before finishing. You can use any title from the catalog for each entry.
notice: All books are complete English ebooks, 160 pages, available now and included in the same plan. Each reader receives their own copy. Morgan’s note: “For my gift, I would like a fictional mystery with clues and a solution.”
